card.name: Linking words before brain-related terms
card.fires_on: Small linking words (of, as, such as, with, and, a) right before a brain-related term. Typical settings are neurologic complications, amyloid imaging abnormalities, and brain surgery.

modes.label: Before neurologic complications
modes.description: Linking words after hyponatremia correction warnings, just before a brain condition such as osmotic demyelination.
modes.example: Rapid correction of hyponatremia is potentially dangerous with risk<< of>> serious neurologic complications such as osm

modes.label: Amyloid imaging abnormalities
modes.description: Words inside or before ARIA terms, which are brain imaging findings.
modes.example: QEMBI, can cause amyloid related imaging abnormalities (ARIA), as ARIA with edema (<<AR>>IA-E) and ARIA with hemos

modes.label: Brain surgery steps
modes.description: Linking words in neurosurgical access instructions, before skull or burr hole terms.
